study type: Interventional study with a historical cohort
outcome: Incidence of preterm birth before 37 weeks
Incidence of preterm birth before 34 weeks
cohort: The study included women with singleton pregnancies after abdominal trachelectomy (AT) for early-stage cervical cancer, divided into a VP intervention group and a historical control group.
finding: The administration of vaginal progesterone did not significantly reduce the rate of preterm birth among pregnant women after abdominal trachelectomy.
gest_age: Vaginal progesterone administration was started between 16+ and 19+6 weeks of gestation; primary outcomes included preterm birth before 37 weeks and 34 weeks of gestation.
